description: Copernicus Publications' journal class copernicus.cls v10.1.34 (27 July 2026) with its journal configuration copernicus.cfg (3 September 2026) and copernicus.bst v1.6, from the Copernicus LaTeX Macro Package v7.16 (publications.copernicus.org/Copernicus_LaTeX_Package.zip, linked from the journals' manuscript-preparation pages), used by all EGU journals. Not on CTAN or the engine's mirror; the package says each file has its own copyright, Copernicus GmbH (no open licence; kept private). Options as the template (template.tex l.12: [journal abbreviation, manuscript]): acp (Atmospheric Chemistry and Physics) and manuscript, the one-column preprint layout; without manuscript the class sets the final two-column layout. The class refuses every standard size, paper and column option (a4paper ... fleqn, l.89-105) with \@latexerr, so setup B (twocolumn) cannot be used. The class loads article [fleqn], ulem [normalem], [T5,T3,T1]{fontenc}, fontawesome5 with fontawesomesymbols-pdftex.tex, inputenc [utf8] (all but LuaTeX), babel (english), amssymb, amsmath [intlimits,fleqn,tbtags], amsthm, natbib [authoryear,round] (l.2038-2039) and, unless nohyperref, hyperref [bookmarks=true,colorlinks] (l.2306-2313). \runningtitle and \runningauthor are required: the class stops with 'You must define \runningtitle' if either is empty (l.552-553), so the preamble gives both, as the template does.
